title: An infographic of my favorite color
summary: The color is blue. There is nothing else to chart.

blocks.title: Blue
blocks.body: It's a good color. Deep without being gloomy, calm without being boring. Works on a wall, a truck, or a Tuesday.

blocks.title: Why there is no chart here
blocks.body: A favorite color is one data point, and one data point drawn as a pie chart is a circle. The honest infographic for 'blue' is the word blue and this sentence admitting it.
